rv.q: Yet in the musical version of "High Fidelity," directed by Walter Bobbie, these overgrown lads have shed both their sting and their pain.
Still, "High Fidelity" definitely deserves a place in my own catalog of Top 5 lists.

tn.cat: Best Scenic Design of a Musical

cn.t: Critics find "High Fidelity" instantly forgettable, with one reviewer noting the musical "erases itself from your memory even as you watch it" and struggles to leave any lasting impression.

vs.sum: The Imperial Theatre offers good sightlines with minimal obstructions and solid sound quality, though some seats may miss minor stage action. While the ambiance is enhanced by its historic architectural design, comfort is average with decent legroom. Facilities are lacking, with long restroom lines being a common issue.

acc.note: 5 wheelchair locations in Orchestra. No steps from sidewalk. Infrared devices available.
